info.name: Collection Manager - Catalogue Service
info.description:
Tests for the Catalogue service (F1 maintain item records, F2 find items, F3 duplicate detection), its Cloudflare Turnstile protection and its integration with the Valuation service.

Folder 1 runs against a local backend that uses Cloudflare's TEST Turnstile secret key, which accepts any token, so only the missing-token case can be refused locally. It creates its own users and collection, so it can be run any number of times. Folder 2 runs against the deployed API with an account and items created on the website (the real Turnstile key refuses test tokens).
